properties.fullDescription: A deceptively spacious two bedroom upper level mews style home (1048 sqft) provides flexible living space in a private and convenient location with the rare benefit of garaging, storage and cleverly contoured landscaped gardens.Kell Mews is an intriguing and individual bungalow / apartment style dwelling quietly situated to the rear of a significant Victorian home and boasting its own garaging and private garden areas.With gas fired heating and double glazing, a private entrance hall serves an elegant sitting room with windows to two elevations and feature beams, and also a 26'6 family dining kitchen with an extensive provision of sleek, contemporary fitted cabinets integrated appliances and quartz work surfaces.Twin doors then serve a further inner hall with two double bedrooms, a house bathroom and a separate shower room / WC.From the main entrance to Kell House the driveway eventually leads to a shared rear courtyard with pedestrian and vehicular access to a substantial integral garage and a useful separate storeroom/workshop. Steps lead to the entrance area from which there is a cleverly laid out combination of ornamental gardens and seating area/decking bounded by wrought iron railings. Steps then lead to a choice of seating areas with elevated aspects above the property and sundeck towards the township of Pateley Bridge and Nidderdale beyond.An ideal opportunity for the buyer seeking a combination of privacy and ease of access to Pateley Bridge with its bustling facilities and regular public transport services to Harrogate and further afield.Proceeding out of Pateley Bridge on the High Street and continuing on Ripon Road, the private driveway serving Kell Mews and Kell House will be identified on the left hand side after approximately 200 yards.
